purpose: The smallest wet-lab program capable of answering the three decisive biology questions that block P-04. NOT documentation — experimental plan with go/no-go gates.
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV — stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck. The enzyme is a biology question. This program confronts it directly.

the_three_questions.question: Which enzyme actually works in CSF?
Can it remain active when immobilized?
Does pulsation-synchronized contact time materially improve catalytic clearance?

design_principle: Each phase has a GO/NO-GO gate. If a phase fails, the program stops. No documentation is written around a failed phase. This is the opposite of the R276 pattern where we built TTPs around an unresolved enzyme.

phase_1_which_enzyme.question: Which enzyme actually works in CSF?
phase_1_which_enzyme.method: In vitro activity assay of candidate enzymes in synthetic CSF at 37°C over 30 days

candidates.name: Neprilysin (NEP)
candidates.rationale: Best-characterized Aβ-degrading enzyme. Recombinant human NEP commercially available.

candidates.name: Matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9)
candidates.rationale: Degrades Aβ in vitro. Less specific than NEP but more stable as recombinant protein.

synthetic_csf_recipe.protein_content: 0.5 g/L bovine serum albumin (mimics CSF protein load)
synthetic_csf_recipe.ion_content: Na+ 150 mM, K+ 3 mM, Ca2+ 1 mM, Mg2+ 1 mM, Cl- 150 mM

assay_protocol.day_0: Add recombinant enzyme to synthetic CSF at 1 μM final concentration. Split into 30 aliquots.
assay_protocol.daily_days_1_30: Assay one aliquot per day for Aβ-degradation activity. Method: incubate with 100 nM Aβ42 for 1 hour, measure remaining Aβ42 by ELISA.

go_no_go_gate.go_criterion: At least ONE candidate retains >= 50% activity at day 30
go_no_go_gate.no_go_action: If no candidate retains >= 50% at day 30, P-04 is DEAD. No Phase 2. No documentation. Record in cemetery.

outputs: Activity retention curve (30 days) for each candidate
If GO: winning enzyme identity, optimal concentration, activity decay rate

phase_2_immobilized_activity.question: Can the winning enzyme from Phase 1 remain active when immobilized?
phase_2_immobilized_activity.method: Immobilize winning enzyme using 2 strategies. Measure activity retention over 30 days in synthetic CSF.

immobilization_strategies.name: PEG hydrogel entrapment
immobilization_strategies.rationale: Biocompatible. Gentle on enzyme. Tunable mesh size.

phase_2_immobilized_activity.assay_protocol: Same as Phase 1 but on immobilized enzyme membranes. Flow synthetic CSF across membrane at 0.30 mL/min, 37°C, pulsatile (1 Hz, 40% amplitude). Daily Aβ degradation assay.

go_no_go_gate.go_criterion: At least ONE immobilization strategy retains >= 30% activity at day 30 (lower threshold than Phase 1 because immobilization always loses some activity)
go_no_go_gate.no_go_action: If no strategy retains >= 30% at day 30, try one more strategy (sol-gel silica). If that also fails, P-04 is DEAD.

outputs: Immobilized activity retention curve (30 days) for each strategy
If GO: winning enzyme + immobilization combination, measured Km and kcat

phase_3_pulsation_sync_benefit.question: Does pulsation-synchronized contact time materially improve catalytic clearance?
phase_3_pulsation_sync_benefit.method: Bench flow cell with winning enzyme+immobilization membrane. Compare clearance under fixed-flow vs pulsation-synchronized flow.

experimental_design.setup: Bench-top flow cell per P-04_FREEZE/EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_HANDOFF/frozen_protocol_engineering_only.json, but with REAL enzymatic membrane from Phase 2
experimental_design.substrate: Synthetic CSF spiked with 100 nM Aβ42 (physiological range)
experimental_design.measurement: Aβ42 concentration proximal and distal to membrane. Clearance = (C_proximal - C_distal) / C_proximal.

go_no_go_gate.go_criterion: Pulsatile_sync clearance >= 1.3x fixed_flow clearance (the hypothesis predicts 1.3-1.5x). Material improvement.
go_no_go_gate.no_go_action: If pulsation sync does NOT improve clearance by >= 1.3x, the P-04 differentiator (pulsation-synchronized contact time lock) is NOT supported. P-04 becomes 'enzymatic CSF clearance membrane' without the pulsation sync feature. Value proposition weakens but does not die.

outputs: Clearance comparison: fixed vs pulsatile-nosync vs pulsatile-sync
GO/NO-GO decision for P-04 as a whole
If GO: P-04 has a validated differentiator. Proceed to pre-clinical.
If PARTIAL: P-04 becomes enzymatic clearance without pulsation sync. Reduced value proposition.

program_summary.kill_probability_estimate: 30-50% (enzyme may not survive 30 days in CSF; immobilization may lose too much activity; pulsation sync may not improve clearance)
program_summary.honest_disclosure: This program may conclude that P-04 is not viable. That is a valid outcome. If so, the finding enters the cemetery and we stop spending money on P-04. This is the opposite of the R276 pattern where we built documentation around an unresolved enzyme.

what_happens_after_phase_3_GO.if_all_three_phases_pass: P-04 has: (1) a specific enzyme that works in CSF, (2) an immobilization strategy that retains activity, (3) evidence that pulsation sync improves clearance. The package promotes from TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED_DESIGN_FREEZE_PARTIAL to PROTOTYPE_READY. Then: pre-clinical animal model, then clinical trial.
what_happens_after_phase_3_GO.if_phase_3_fails_but_1_2_pass: P-04 becomes 'enzymatic CSF clearance membrane' without pulsation sync. Reduced but still viable value proposition. Package promotes to PROTOTYPE_READY with revised claims.

collaborator_requirements.phase_1: Biochemistry lab with enzyme assay capability. Any university biochem lab can do this.
collaborator_requirements.phase_2: Biomaterials lab with immobilization expertise. Slightly more specialized.
collaborator_requirements.phase_3: Bioengineering lab with flow cell + pulsatile pump capability. Same as P-01 bench prototype lab.
collaborator_requirements.ideal_collaborator: A single lab that can do all three phases. E.g., a bioengineering department with a biomaterials subgroup. Examples: MIT BME, Stanford BME, Rice BME, Northwestern BME.
